The light blue circle surrounding the blue dot on Google Maps is not just for decoration. According to official help, it appears when your current location cannot be pinpointed accurately, and the smaller the circle, the higher the positioning accuracy.

In other words, even if the blue dot is in the center of a large circle, it is premature to conclude that 'you are definitely at this exact spot.' The app itself is indicating that it has not narrowed down your location.
